item.title: Elkhart Community Schools teacher being investigated for misconduct with former student
item.description: ELKHART COUNTY, Ind. -- ABC57 obtained a letter addressed to parents from Elkhart Community Schools regarding an ongoing criminal investigation into a current teacher for alleged misconduct with a former student.

item.title: "Do not drive" warning issued, airbag recalls on several Crysler, Dodge, Jeep, and Ram vehicles
item.description: BOISE, Idaho -- Stellantis, the parent company of Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep and Ram, has issued a "do not drive" warning for vehicles with unrepaired Takata airbags, which had been recalled.

item.title: Pointe Apartments owners face demolition despite claiming to spend hundreds of thousands of dollars on repairs
item.description: PLYMOUTH, Ind. -- City leaders in Plymouth are closing in on plans to tear down the vacant Pointe Apartments building.

item.title: VSBM Releases record-breaking 2025 report
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. — Visit South Bend Mishawaka came out with its 2025 annual report. It outlines greater hotel demand, successful events, local development and the success of regional attractions.

item.title: Elkhart officials urge patience as investigation continues into officer involved shooting of teen
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. — Gut wrenching video taken by one of the teenagers in a car shows the moments after his friend was shot and killed by Elkhart police Sunday.

item.title: Elkhart Police Chief and Mayor hold press conference following shooting of 14-year-old, recent shootings
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. — Elkhart Police Chief Dan Milanese and Mayor Rod Roberson held an hour long press conference Wednesday afternoon to address concerns surrounding recent acts of violence in the city.

item.title: Andrea Johnson sentenced in school board election fraud
item.description: GOSHEN, Ind. -- Andrea Johnson has been sentenced to 18 months of probation for Filing a Fraudulent Report and 180 days probation for Accepting a Contribution Made in Another's Name.

item.title: One dead and two injured following crash on C.R. 5
item.description: ELKHART COUNTY, Ind. -- Elkhart County Crash Investigation Team is investigating a crash on C.R. 5, south of C.R.2, involving two vehicles.

item.title: Several departments respond to a house fire in Benton Harbor
item.description: BERRIEN COUNTY, Mich. -- The Benton Harbor Department of Public Safety (BHDPS) automatic aid companies were dispatched to the scene of a house fire Wednesday afternoon around 2:40 on Ogden Avenue.

item.title: Local Michiana soccer clubs merge, an idea in the works for over two decades
item.description: NORTHERN INDIANA -- Two local soccer clubs are merging into one, as Michiana Echo Premier and Junior Irish are joining forces to become the Northern Indiana Football Club. The idea of a merger has been in the works for more than two decades.
